file.label: Upload {{type}} file
file.help:
The import takes a list of items, not a list of who brings what. Sign-ups are built from the participants afterwards.
If there is a header row we match columns by what it says: item name, quantity and notes. Other columns are not read.
With no header row the order is item name, quantity, notes.

file.badEncoding: This file was not saved in an encoding we can read, so its text comes out garbled. In Excel, save it as CSV UTF-8, or simply save it as an Excel file.

hero.title: Community Meal Management
hero.subtitle: The platform that turns logistical coordination into a seamless experience, so you can focus on food and human connection.

text.part2:
Just send them a link, they choose what to bring, and that's it.
No passwords, no downloads, no headache.

features.title: Tools to Make Your Life Easier

smartImport.title: Smart AI Import
smartImport.description: Enter a list as text, voice message, or upload an image - our Artificial Intelligence will build the event item list for you in seconds.

carpooling.title: Smart Carpooling
carpooling.description: No need for a separate WhatsApp group for rides. Participants can offer available seats or request a ride directly through the event page.

noRegistration.title: No Registration Required
noRegistration.description: Your guests do not need to create an account, remember passwords, or download an app. Simple entry via a link and they are in.

story.title: Why did we build this?
story.p1: "Sometimes the best ideas are born not in the office, but around a Shabbat table. As someone who participates in community meals, I experienced the magic of shared meals - but also the logistical headache."
story.p2: "Managing 'who brings what' via Google Sheets was cumbersome, not mobile-friendly, and prone to errors. Someone accidentally deleted a row, others struggled with editing on the phone, and the event manager worked too hard."
story.p3: "Shishi-Shitufi was born to solve exactly this. We built a dedicated solution that creates a seamless experience, zero errors, and peace of mind for event managers."
